about: The 360-degree rooms of the 3D scene (scene3d.html, game.html): one entry per room, read by src/scene3d-room.ts (readRegister). The pictures are media and lie outside Git under assets/scene/; this file names each by its SHA-256 and says where it came from. blur, exposure, turn, mirror, air, tint and light are how the scene shows the room (see the comment on Panorama in src/scene3d-room.ts); sound is the room sound of src/lab-sound.ts it is heard with; game says whether the game's Bord menu offers it. A new room is tried in the lab (Miljö) and reaches the game only when Jakob has approved it there. Photographs are Poly Haven HDRIs (CC0), taken as Poly Haven's own tonemapped JPG and made the size of the forest room (4096x2048); the originals and Poly Haven's download receipts lie in assets/scene/source/ (copied 2026-11-12 from the room study's work folder on D:, receipt.json beside them). A room whose source has a lens (Monaco and the den, 2026-11-13) is no 360-degree picture: it is one wide generated still laid on the sphere behind the dealer through that lens (degrees across and up), with the rest of the sphere filled from the still's own edges (source.made); its still, its loop film, the film as Runway made it and the raw material's LASMIG.md (prompts and task ids) lie in assets/scene/source/, receipt-rum2.json beside them.

source.filmModel: wan3, 480p: seven takes of 10 s (Runway MCP), each starting and ending on a still (the room's still, or the last frame of the take in which a guest walks to the far wall), joined 2026-11-14 by dealer-f6 into one loop of 3653 frames (121.8 s) with D:/dealer-scratch/tmp/levande-objekt/rumsliv/foga.mjs: two frames left out at each end of a take, 15 frames faded over at each join, every frame levelled to the first take on the ceiling; laid through the still's lens with life.mjs there (three quarters of the box, crf 26). The order of the takes, what each shows and what it cost are in assets/scene/source/monaco-lasmig.md
source.made: Made 2026-11-13 by dealer-f6 (D:/dealer-scratch/tmp/levande-objekt/rum2/pano.mjs): the still as a level flat picture seen through a lens of 110° × 62.4°, horizon at its middle, laid on the sphere with its middle behind the dealer; the rest of the sphere filled from the still's own edges, mirrored across its side edges and across its top and bottom edge (the first 14°, then held), blurred more with the distance from the still (a Gaussian whose sigma is 0.08 of the distance, both in picture pixels) and darkened by up to 55 % at 110° from it; saved with sharp as JPEG quality 90 (mozjpeg).
